rulings.reason: The instruction operationalizes the score as a count of coined acronyms/brand names plus the density of free-standing statistics, which measures packaging and writing register, not the motivation, method, or findings; hype-free phrasing is neither necessary nor sufficient for sound research, and a strong paper that names its benchmark is penalized. A lower-marketing writing culture may still track a more careful research group, so report it discounted and undiscounted.
